description: Magnaloy Coupling Company — small fluid-power/couplings manufacturer. Alpena, MI. Real site. Classic older small-shop layout; sells via distributors (Motion Industries, Applied Industrial Technologies). 'Connecting Fluid Power For Over 60 Years'.

expected.ship_area_guess: US + international (via distributor network: Motion Industries, Applied Industrial Technologies)
expected.brands_note: Single-house small manufacturer. The only brand is its own. Distributors (Motion Industries, Applied Industrial Technologies) are CHANNEL partners, NOT brands carried — a key false-positive stress test: the extractor must not list Motion/Applied as carried brands.
expected.notes: The 'messy small shop' fixture. Edge cases: (1) distributor names must not be mistaken for carried brands; (2) the home page doubles as a product catalog nav.
